name_en: Pension Scheme for Destitute Unmarried Poor Women aged 50 and above
department: Revenue Administration and Disaster Management Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: You get Rs 1,200 every month (from August 2023). You also get a free saree at Pongal and Deepavali, and free rice.

other: You must be destitute (no one to support you) and never married.
Your fixed assets (house, land) must not be worth more than Rs 1,00,000.

how_to_apply: Apply online on the TN e-Sevai website (tnesevai.tn.gov.in). Revenue officers check your form. If you are eligible, the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) orders your pension. Forms are settled within 30 days.
